user.title: Jarvis
user.description: Jarvis on the PC answers what the voice satellite hears. Get the key on the phone at <Jarvis address>/pair.html?schluessel (code from the PC HUD under Devices).

data_description.url: The tailscale serve address, e.g. https://my-pc.tailXXXX.ts.net
data_description.key: Shown once on pair.html?schluessel. Lost or leaked: delete it under Devices in the HUD and get a new one.
data_description.ip: Only needed when this machine cannot resolve the ts.net name (Tailscale with accept-dns off).

reconfigure.title: Jarvis
reconfigure.description: Change the address or enter a new key.
